in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the lion among men

in_marathi.name: Vivekanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vivekanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vivekanand is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Vivek' meaning wisdom and 'Anand' meaning bliss. It signifies the attainment of wisdom and the resulting happiness and bliss. In Hinduism, this name is associated with the revered monk Swami Vivekananda, who was a key figure in the spread of Hinduism and Indian culture across the world.
